    "The standoffs and terminal blocks feel useful because they would help me mount my existing boards and connect wiring for my relay projects, provided they fit.",

    "My electronics purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any electronic component, even when its purpose is far from my existing projects.",
    "Similarity to something I already own seems to count too heavily, especially for bulk packs that would duplicate my supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about whether a part fills a gap in my existing supplies, rather than simply resembling a previous purchase.",
    "Footprint, voltage and practical purpose matter before I choose specialized components; my history does not establish those requirements.",
    "My latest purchase was caster wheels, so the older electronics purchases alone do not establish that I am currently stocking up for another circuit project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my electronics interests but miss the distinction between useful additions, duplicate supplies and parts needing a specific project."
}
